title: Compact playbook visuals for timeout & retry flows in Quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact visual playbook for Quickstart onboarding that explains timeout, retry, and rate limit states across product screenshots and docs. The goal is to reduce first-time user confusion and support NPS by providing: a compact one-column 'rescue card' for in-app quick help, a 3-step infographic for docs, annotated API response screenshots for console docs, and a lightweight animated SVG for error-state transitions used in the onboarding flow. Assets must be responsive and run under 150KB total for inline SVG/PNG combos.
acceptance_criteria: One responsive 'rescue card' component with text alternatives available in Figma and exported HTML/CSS snippet
Three annotated API console screenshots (desktop/tablet/mobile) with callouts for retry guidance and links to retry SDK helper
1 compact 3-step docs infographic (SVG) that explains rate limits→timeouts→retries and fallback ordering
Accessibility audit notes with contrast ratios and motion-reduce variants in the Design doc
Exported asset package (SVG/PNG/animated GIF) and a developer-ready code snippet in the linked GH PR
tasks: Sketch 2 layout variants (compact card and vertical stack)
Produce annotated console screenshots with overlays and copy
Create 3-step infographic SVG and a reduced-motion GIF variant
Record micro-interaction spec and handoff tokens (colors, durations)
Finalize assets and upload to Drive, add to design system assets page
Create GH PR with HTML/CSS snippet and test in staging quickstart flow
comments: 2025-02-14 Maya Chen: Kickoff — gathered requirements from PM and eng. PM asked for smallest possible footprint for in-app rescue card to avoid adding load time to quickstart.
2025-02-16 Liam O'Connor: Posted initial sketches in Figma, requested tighter copy and more explicit retry steps for SDK vs API users.

2025-02-18 Engineering review (Anika Patel): Prefers SVG icons and wants a single animated sprite for retry pulsing to reduce bundle size; asked to add a non-animated fallback for AMP-like environments.
2025-02-19 Design review (Rachel Kim): Approved color palette but requested improved contrast for error text; recommended replacing 'retry' microcopy with 'Try again' for tone consistency.
2025-02-20 Maya Chen: Iterated on screenshots; uploaded preliminary assets to Drive; opened GH PR #4867 for HTML snippet (link below). Ready for QA review.
